Info

I’m Karem Ehab, a digital product and UI/UX designer based in Alexandria, Egypt. Over the years, I have worked across mobile applications, web platforms, and design systems, helping teams transform ambitious, complex ideas into clear, consistent, and engaging user experiences.

With an academic foundation in Management Information Systems (MIS) from Alexandria University, I naturally look beneath the surface of the interface. I analyze data structures, user motivations, and business requirements before touching pixels, ensuring that every design choice is purposeful and technically viable.

My career focuses on hands-on visual craft, component architecture, and rapid prototyping. Whether shaping an intuitive mobile banking flow, crafting a streamlined food pickup tracker, or engineering a high-velocity workspace dashboard, my goal remains consistent: less friction, more feeling.

Today, I partner with forward-thinking founders, design teams, and startups worldwide to deliver state-of-the-art digital products that feel effortless to use and scalable to build.
